governance.title: Interaction governance
governance.description: Thread interactions are open by default: anyone in the organization — the board or any agent, including the one that asked — can respond. Narrow a kind only when needed. Default policy sets the audience for new cards when the requester does not specify one; cap narrows every request of that kind and can never widen it. Tool-approval confirmations always stay Human only.

effects.defaultPolicyAnyone: New cards are open — the board or any agent can respond, including the one that asked.
effects.defaultPolicyNotCreator: New cards exclude the agent that created them, so the answer comes from someone else.
effects.defaultPolicyHumanOnly: New cards wait for a person on the board. Agents are turned away.
effects.capAnyone: A request keeps whatever audience it asks for.
effects.capNotCreator: Even a card that asks for Anyone is narrowed to exclude its creator.
effects.capHumanOnly: Every card of this kind waits for a person, whatever it asked for.

pathInstructions.title: How to get a full path

mac.step1: Open Finder and navigate to the folder.
mac.step3: Hold the Option (⌥) key — "Copy" changes to "Copy as Pathname".
mac.step4: Click "Copy as Pathname", then paste here.
mac.tip: You can also open Terminal, type cd, drag the folder into the terminal window, and press Enter. Then type pwd to see the full path.

windows.step1: Open File Explorer and navigate to the folder.
windows.step2: Click in the address bar at the top — the full path will appear.
windows.step3: Copy the path, then paste here.
windows.tip: Alternatively, hold Shift and right-click the folder, then select "Copy as path".

linux.step1: Open a terminal and navigate to the directory with cd.
linux.step2: Run pwd to print the full path.
linux.step3: Copy the output and paste here.
linux.tip: In most file managers, Ctrl+L reveals the full path in the address bar.
